args.body:
Harbor State’s BDC holdings saw new signs of stress this month.

FIXTURE GOLF CAPITAL CORP: two first-lien senior secured loans marked down, with Cedar Ridge Dental Partners LLC moving from 98.0 to 91.5 in row 102 of 0009000011-26-000111 and Granite Peak Manufacturing LLC moving from 98.5 to 92.0 in row 106 of the same filing.

FIXTURE HOTEL SENIOR LENDING: the filing showed one maturity extension and one new PIK increase. Pinecrest Learning Group Inc.’s first-lien term loan extended from 2029-09-30 to 2031-09-30 in row 105 of 0009000012-26-000121. Oakmont Home Services LLC’s first-lien term loan moved from 1.0 to 3.0 PIK in row 104 of the same filing. Brightwater Fitness Holdings LLC also marked down from 99.0 to 93.5 in row 101.

FIXTURE JULIETT LENDING BDC: one first-lien term loan extended and another moved to higher PIK. Dunmore Insurance Brokers LLC extended from 2028-03-15 to 2030-03-15 in row 104 of 0009000014-26-000141. Foxglove Specialty Pharma Inc. moved from 0.0 to 2.5 PIK in row 106 of the same filing. Crestline Roofing Holdings LLC also marked down from 97.5 to 90.0 in row 103.

Overall, the month points to more credit slippage across all three holdings, led by markdowns, two maturity extensions, and two new or higher PIK moves.
